mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_revenue_stats (tenant_id, stat_date, total_revenue, total_orders, total_tips, avg_order_value, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{statDate}, #{totalRevenue}, #{totalOrders}, #{totalTips}, #{avgOrderValue}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_revenue = #{totalRevenue}, total_orders = #{totalOrders}, total_tips = #{totalTips}, avg_order_value = #{avgOrderValue}, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM daily_revenue_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date = #{statDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_revenue), 0) FROM daily_revenue_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_orders), 0) FROM daily_revenue_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_tips), 0) FROM daily_revenue_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_revenue_stats WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
